name: MapViewer3D
description: Live 3D map of Hagga Basin and Deep Desert with players, bases, vehicles, hazards and resources. Nothing to install on the server: terrain and models stream from GitHub, live data comes from the console API with a key you create (Settings > API Keys: maps Read, bases Read). Live worms, NPCs, vehicles and storms appear when the console offers Realtime Data.
author: dev-prophet-code
